entities.name: MCP

evidence.quote: Another interesting part I wanted to highlight here is we have our own internal MCP server called Context Automatic, and this allows us to rapidly add new tooling sets for MCPs that might not exist or that we want to build our own governance and observability layers on.

evidence.quote: And then we're also attempting to build a shared skill and MCP infrastructure.

evidence.quote: Or these can also be creating new skills or MCPs to enable them to work faster outside of the program.

evidence.quote: So our engineering curriculum starts the first few days, covering the basics, skills, and how to create them, learning how to use MCPs and spectrum and development, as well as kind of the foundations of how to use AI responsibly and how to apply it in a way that's mindful.

evidence.quote: So again, that context aid C system that I mentioned, but also encouraging people to create and share skills and build on top of each other's work so that we're all kind of building towards the same kind of platform.
